newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African wool prices fall at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: South African wool prices fall at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices fell at the season's weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
7,827 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 93 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron fell 2.4 percent, but 21 micron rose 0.2 percent. 22 micron fell 3.5 percent, 23 micron fell 7.7 percent, 24 micron fell 4.8 percent and 25 micron fell 7.1 percent.
Prices for Merino bellies fell 5.0 percent, Merino lambs rose 6.0 percent and Merino locks rose 0.5 percent.
The offering included 2,076 bales of Merino, 1,720 bales of other white wool, 1,207 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 1,654 bales of Lesotho and 1,172 bales of Coarse & Coloured wool.

Of the 121 bales of 20 micron offered, 98.4 percent were sold. Of 545 bales of 21 micron offered, 97.4 percent were sold, of 1,471 bales of 22 micron offered 94.4 percent were sold, of 1,368 bales of 23 micron offered 83.3 percent were sold, of 982 bales of 24 micron offered 93.3 percent were sold and of the 320 bales of 25 micron offered 89.7 percent were sold.
The next sale will take place on September 11, offering about 10,000 bales.
